title: HR 5110 (118th Congress): Protecting Hunting Heritage and Education Act
operative_text: Sec. 2 (amending Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 sec. 8526(7), 20 U.S.C. 7906(7)): Section 8526(7) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 7906(7)) is amended by inserting , except that this paragraph shall not apply to the use of funds under this Act for activities carried out under programs authorized by this Act that are otherwise permissible under such programs and that provide students with educational instruction or educational enrichment activities, such as archery, hunting, other shooting sports, or culinary arts before the period at the end.

votes.motion: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended (Roll 407)
